project_type: Next.js 14 App Router prop trading firm website (ApexFunded)
verification_instructions: Run next build to verify no TypeScript or build errors. Run next lint to check linting.
environment_constraints: No .env file present so Supabase calls will fail at runtime, but build/lint should pass. Focus on UI changes only.
contribution_requirements: Work on the 'uncheck' branch (default). No specific contribution guide beyond standard Next.js patterns.
key_patterns: Components are client-side ('use client'), use framer-motion for animations, lucide-react for icons, Tailwind CSS with custom theme (dark luxury - gold/royal/emerald/rose accents). Glass morphism effects (glass, glass-strong classes). Gradient text (gradient-text, lux-text). Premium buttons (btn-primary, btn-secondary). Cards use ring-conic, lux-card patterns. Layout uses glow-blob for ambient lighting effects. Path alias @/* maps to project root.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and components. app/components/ - All UI components for landing page. app/dashboard/ - User dashboard (single page). app/admin/ - Admin panel. app/api/ - API routes. lib/ - Utility files (db.ts for Supabase). tailwind.config.ts - Custom theme with luxury dark colors.
